In most cases I don't consider HTTP method as user-input which you need to validate by program code.

Architecture must be written the way that with "wrong" HTTP method an application will not execute functionality for input validation which was meant to be executed (only) with other HTTP method. Think about REST - it just defines, which action you want to call. But as this requirement is not REST specific in general, I recommend to move it from V13 to V14.

It's more architecture/configuration problem, can be considered to move also to V1.14 subcategory.
